lines: Earth type blunt attack on random enemy (L) x5, [180% x MOD x 5] and Power -35% and Intelligence -35% (1 turn)
* +100% damage when at max HP (Multiplier x2)
* All hits have same AF combo gain as first hit.
* When used consecutively, decrease number of hits and Reduce debuff effects:
** Number of hits: x5 > x3 > x1 > x1 ...
** Total multiplier: 900% > 540% > 180% > ...
** Effect reverts to max after using any other skill.
